mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 enzymes (1A2, 2C9, 2D6, 3A4) which may reduce tazarotene metabolism, potentially increasing retinoid exposure and teratogenic risk.
action: Monitor for signs of retinoid toxicity (headache, skin irritation, photosensitivity); consider alternative H2-blocker if concerns arise. Ensure adequate contraception in women of childbearing age.
